Strace-macOS: A clone of the strace command for macOS
item.description:
📝 txt /usr/local/bin/git status # JSON output strace --json /usr/local/bin/git status > trace. jsonl # Filter syscalls by name strace -e trace=open,close /usr/local/bin/git status # Filter by category* strace -e trace=file /usr/local/bin/git status # All file operations strace -e trace=network /usr/local/bin/curl https://example. com # Network syscalls only strace -e trace=process /usr/local/bin/git status # Process lifecycle syscalls * See Syscall Filtering for all supported categories.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/Mic92/strace-macos
